messages:
ash: Heads-up: prod-apse1 has a sudden spike of tiny GPU pods Pending (~88) while several nodes report ~0.5 free GPU each. Started ~28m ago. :confused:
mei: Grafana: cluster/gpu_pending_count=88, warmpool/util=18%, node/free_fraction avg=0.48. Any recent taint/label rollouts?
raj: We rolled "reserve-dedicated" taint yesterday to avoid mixed racks: `gpu:reserved=true:NoSchedule`. Looks like the taint applied broadly due to a selector bug.
ash: snippet: 
```
# kubectl get pods -n prod | grep Pending
mini-infer-12    Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate
rerank-lite-3    Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient gpu
```
ops-bot: ALERT: [gpu-pending-pods] cluster-prod-apse1 threshold breached (count=88) at 3001122300
mei: autoscaler tried to scale but cloud returned `InsufficientCapacity` for spot in apse1. Quota ok but spot supply poor. Cloud-ops ticket CLOUD-9633 opened.
raj: immediate mitigations: 1) patch critical tiny deployments to tolerate `gpu:reserved=true` 2) enable fractional coalescing for tiny class temporarily 3) spin a small on-demand tiny pool if spot fails.
ash: I patched a canary deployment with toleration. Command: `kubectl patch deploy mini-infer -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations/-","value":{"key":"gpu:reserved","operator":"Equal","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}}]'`
infra-bot: Patch applied to mini-infer by ash at 3001122338.
mei: after patching ~15% of tiny replicas pending dropped from 88 -> 26 in ~9 minutes and warmpool util rose to 56%. Cost bump ~6% for rack but stabilized.
raj: long-term fixes: - tighten the taint agent selector so reserved taint only lands on nodes labeled `workload_bucket=training` - add a preflight canary: 5% nodes, monitor pending_gpu delta for 20m abort if delta > 8 - scheduler: add per-workload coalesce whitelist (tiny/background) - autoscaler: try cross-region fallback for non-latency-critical jobs before failing.
ash: created INFRA-2301 with runbook stub (patch tolerations, scale provisioner, revert labeler). Assign owners: @raj (labeler), @mei (autoscaler), @ash (runbook).
ops-bot: Incident INFRA-2301 created by ash at 3001122385.
mei: current status at 3001122400: pending=12, warmpool util=52%. Removing pages, leaving alert on. Will follow up with postmortem in #eng-infra once INFRA-2301 is complete. :thumbsup:
